about: For each source file: the level that introduced it, the later levels that changed it, and its one responsibility. tests/architecture.test.ts checks this file. The course page reads it.

shared/money.ts.role: Money as integer cents: text to cents, cents to text.

shared/contracts.ts.role: The data contracts of the web application and the server, and the check of shape.

shared/contracts.test.ts.role: Proves each rule of shape with a FAIL case.

server/main.ts.role: Composition root: makes all the parts and connects them.

server/config.ts.role: Reads the settings from the environment.

server/clock.ts.role: Ports for time and identifiers, with fixed versions for tests.

server/errors.ts.role: The expected errors and the status code of each.

server/domain/expense.ts.role: The expense as pure functions: proposal, merchant key, month.

server/domain/budget.ts.role: The state of a budget from a limit and a spent amount.

server/domain/budget.test.ts.role: Proves the four budget states and the month edges.

server/domain/expense-rules.ts.role: The business rules R5 to R7 as one pure function.

server/domain/expense-rules.test.ts.role: Proves each business rule with PASS and FAIL.

server/repositories/ports.ts.role: The interfaces of the stores. Services know only these.

server/repositories/memory.ts.role: The stores in memory, for tests.

server/repositories/sqlite.ts.role: The stores in SQLite. The only SQL of the three tables.

server/repositories/migrate.ts.role: Applies the numbered schema files, forward only.

server/repositories/contract.test.ts.role: One suite that the two store implementations must pass.

server/repositories/sqlite-file.test.ts.role: Proves that data stays in a file, and that the database refuses bad data.

server/services/record-expense.ts.role: The use case: record an expense and give the budget.

server/services/record-expense.test.ts.role: Says what 'record an expense' means, in nine cases.

server/services/month-summary.ts.role: The use case: show one month. It only reads.

server/http/handlers.ts.role: One small function for each operation of the API.

server/http/server.ts.role: HTTP: finds the handler, reads JSON, protects the server, maps errors.

server/http/api.test.ts.role: The whole server through real HTTP requests.

web/src/App.tsx.role: Owns the screen state and calls the server.

web/src/api.ts.role: The only file of the web application that calls fetch.

web/src/state.ts.role: The screen state and its pure reducer.

web/src/state.test.ts.role: Proves that a retry keeps the request key.

web/src/ExpenseForm.tsx.role: The form. Shows state, sends actions.

web/src/BudgetPanel.tsx.role: Shows the budgets and the last expenses.

tests/architecture.test.ts.role: Checks the boundaries between the folders and the levels.
